description: INTRADAY profile, setup part: OPENING-RANGE BREAKOUT ENTERED ON A RETEST. The range is the first 6 five-minute candles (09:15-09:45). A breakout is a 5-minute close 0.03% beyond the range. It must stay intact (no close back inside), the price may be at most 0.20% beyond the broken level (no chasing), it must have pulled back to within 0.05% of that level, and the last candle must resume in the trade direction on the right side of the day's average price. No new setup after 13:30. Still OUR choices, NOT validated on real market data. Set require_retest to false to enter on the breakout itself.
